{{samename|volumes published in English by VIZ Media|List of Pokémon Omega Ruby Alpha Sapphire volumes}}
The {{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}} of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by [[Shogakukan]] in Japan, which released up to three volumes total. The volume releases began in July 2015, and later ended in September 2016. Once the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} ended in the regular volumes, the ''Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire'' arc started to be properly collected in that format as well.
